analysisCellStructure.orderOfOperations: within each seed-matched comparison group compute state-vs-rural-spring-summer log contrast; only then summarize the three independent replicate contrasts within the analysis cell

channelDefinitions.additionalScalarColorIndex: NONE_PREDECLARED; spectral/color response is represented by S/P and the full per-wavelength paired log-ratio vector
channelDefinitions.integration: trapezoidal on validated 8001-node 380..780 nm inclusive 0.05-nm serialized radiance grid

johnsonV.response: pinned Bessell V table 470..700 nm at 10 nm, linearly interpolated

channelDefinitions.oneNmGridErrorUpperBoundRelativeInterpre: Reviewed upper bounds attributable to the VROOM 1-nm calculation-grid discretization while channels are integrated from the validated serialized full spectrum.

photopic.response: CIE V(lambda), 380..780 by 10 nm, linear interpolation, exact constants copied from pinned source

scotopic.response: CIE V-prime(lambda), 380..780 by 10 nm, linear interpolation, exact constants copied from pinned source

channelDefinitions.spRatio: scotopicLuminanceScotCdM2 / photopicLuminanceCdM2 when photopic > 0; otherwise undefined

commonRandomNumberUncertainty.forbidden: Do not estimate paired-ratio uncertainty by independent quadrature of state and baseline marginal MC standard deviations; common-random-number covariance is not available from those two files.

marginalMcStdDiagnostic.source: mc.rad.std.spc paired nodewise with mc.rad.spc on the validated 8001-node serialized grid
marginalMcStdDiagnostic.zeroHandling: no epsilon; relative std undefined at zero-radiance nodes

commonRandomNumberUncertainty.marginalMcStdUse: mc.rad.std.spc is a per-case marginal numerical diagnostic and must be retained/reported.
commonRandomNumberUncertainty.rule: The primary contrast uncertainty is estimated from the three independent paired-seed replicate contrasts for each geometry/sun-depression/AOD/state.
summary: preserve all three paired log contrasts
sample standard deviation across the three paired contrasts

crossTwilightConsistency: Report whether a state that brightens early twilight weakens, reverses, or worsens relative behavior at 6-8 degrees; never select the state after seeing results.

descriptiveUncertaintyClassification.magnitudeStability: STABLE only when all three finite replicate contrasts fall in the same preregistered magnitude band; MIXED otherwise; UNRESOLVED if any required contrast is undefined
descriptiveUncertaintyClassification.signConsistency: report CONSISTENT_NONNEGATIVE, CONSISTENT_NONPOSITIVE, MIXED_SIGN, or UNRESOLVED from the three replicate log contrasts

downstreamTimingBoundary: First-star timing sensitivity is outside this radiance challenge and may be evaluated only after radiance physics closes, with stellar transmission and human/field-factor models frozen.
negativeResultMeaning: Small Shettle-family effects do not rule out aerosols generally; next preregistered suspects are SSA, phase function, particle mixture/size distribution, composition and vertical profile.
numericalAdequacy: No adaptive rerun, no result-dependent photon increase, and no estimator/importance-center switch inside this frozen version. If replicate dispersion or marginal MC uncertainty makes an effect ambiguous, classify it as numerically unresolved and create a separate preregistered continuation if warranted.
pairingUnit: one 8-state group sharing sun depression, target altitude, relative azimuth, observer elevation, AOD550, photon histories, numerical method and Monte-Carlo seed
primaryQuestion: At fixed AOD550 and identical geometry/common random seed, how much do Shettle aerosol family and season change twilight sky brightness and the 380-780 nm spectrum?
secondaryContrasts: S/P ratio state-minus-baseline and log-ratio when both positive
per-wavelength ln(radiance_state/radiance_baseline) at all 8001 serialized wavelengths when both positive
no additional scalar color index; spectral/color response is the full paired log-ratio vector plus S/P

spectrumContract.calculationGrid: VROOM wavelength_grid_file: 380..780 nm inclusive at 1 nm (401 nodes)
spectrumContract.rawSerializedGrid: mc.rad.spc and mc.rad.std.spc: expected 380..780 nm inclusive at 0.05 nm (8001 nodes), point tolerance 5e-05 nm

strongRatioFlag: Report a separate directional ratio flag in addition to fractional-change bands: ratio >=1.5 or <=2/3 is STRONG; ratio >=2 or <=0.5 is VERY_LARGE. This flag is descriptive and never a retunable pass/fail gate.
uncertaintyLabelRule: Always show mean, all three replicate contrasts, SD and SE. Also report replicate/mean strong-ratio flags. If replicate magnitudes span multiple interpretation bands or any required contrast is unresolved, set magnitudeInterpretationUncertain=true rather than selecting the desired band.
zeroHandling: No epsilon substitution. Any nonpositive/nonfinite required integrated value makes that paired log contrast undefined and explicitly NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED. Preserve raw zero/nonfinite evidence.
